semantic_conclusion: Every required explanatory body and localized display field reviewed against current English. Every added/changed body had independent review or a separate complete second comparison. Cache generation/queue progress and script success are not semantic evidence; exact final source/target hash witnesses are retained outside Git.
legal_english_exceptions: Executable code/configuration, command comments inside protected examples, actual program output and diagnostics, paths/URLs, argument placeholders, formal API/sample/metric signatures and protocol/header names remain literal.
Proper product/protocol names and standardized identifiers remain Latin; English technical terms explicitly explained in Russian may remain in parentheses.

All un-commented explanatory prose, table labels and argument descriptions are translated. Exact explanation-fence, indented-explanation and embedded-code manifests enforce the boundary without exempting arbitrary code.

A genuine same-page theme translation-source notice may cite the English original, alongside actual same-page language switches and alternate metadata. Ordinary English body links and forged notice attributes are rejected.
